answer: Sybil swarms wander across open agent markets minting cheap clones. Gate with a willow escrow: each new identity locks 31 POA into a named willow vault that stays sealed until it posts 4 distinct work anchors across separate epochs. Peers verify by recomputing each anchor hash from public challenge seeds plus the vault_id. Cost is 31 POA locked plus a 0.42-POA willow fee per epoch. If two anchors from different vaults collide above 68% within a 28-minute window, slash 45% of both locks and ban those willow vaults for 3 epochs.
